name: I Paint Services
niche: residential/commercial painting (stair & railing staining, interior/exterior painting, garage makeovers)
address_note: No public street address. Google Business Profile lists it as a service-area business (mobile/residential painting crew), not a storefront. The lat/lng in the Maps URL (26.4364736, -80.1976876) is the Google Business pin location, not a published office address, so no map embed or street address is shown on the site; contacto.imagen uses a real finished-job photo instead, per the adapted-variant rule.
phone_source: Provided in task brief and independently confirmed on the business's own yard sign photographed on its Google Business Profile (gallery-garage-exterior.jpg / contacto-exterior.jpg source photo shows a sign reading 'iPaint Services, Painting & Structures, 561-909-5890, Social Media @ipaintservices' in front of a freshly painted home).
has_own_site_evidence: Google Maps listing shows 'Add website' (no website on file). WebSearch for '"I Paint Services" West Palm Beach website' and '"I Paint Services" West Palm Beach email contact 561-909-5890' returned no matching business website, Yelp/Thumbtack/Angi/HomeAdvisor profile, or Instagram/Facebook page for this exact business; all results were unrelated West Palm Beach painting companies. Checked domain variants: ipaintservices.com resolves (HTTP 200) but WebFetch shows it is a generic, unconfigured cPanel 'Hosting Active' placeholder page (bilingual EN/ES 'Your Hosting Service is Online!' template with no business name, no painting content, 'Page Courtesy of REINEC'), not a real published business site; ipaintservicesllc.com, ipaintservice.com, ipaintservicewpb.com, ipaintservicesfla.com, i-paintservices.com, ipaintservicesfl.com and ipaintservices.net all failed to resolve. Conclusion: has_own_site = false. The ipaintservices.com registration (if related at all) has no content and does not count as a real website.

social_media.instagram_evidence: The business's own yard sign (photographed in one of its Google Business Profile photos, used as nosotros.avatar on the site) lists 'Social Media @ipaintservices'. WebSearch for 'instagram.com/ipaintservices west palm beach' could not retrieve or verify this profile (Instagram pages are not indexed/fetchable this way), so it is recorded here as an unverified lead only and was NOT used as a data source or linked on the site; the site's secondary social link is Google Maps, per the build instructions, since the IG profile's content/bio could not be independently confirmed.

email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field, only phone), WebSearch for "I Paint Services West Palm Beach email" and the phone number directly (no hits), Thumbtack/Angi/HomeAdvisor/BBB directory searches for this exact business name (not listed under any of these platforms), and the ipaintservices.com domain (confirmed to be an empty default hosting placeholder with no contact info, not a real site). No Facebook or verifiable Instagram page to check a bio/About section. Phone (call or text) is the only real public contact channel for this business; outreach is registered as pending_manual.

services.source: Derived directly from the 5 verbatim Google reviews provided in the task brief and from the real work shown in the business's own Google Business Profile photos (stained staircases, painted garages, painted kitchen cabinets, painted home exteriors). Nothing invented.
list: Stair and railing staining/restaining (featured in 3 of 5 reviews: Janet Algeciras, Rolando Montalvan, Laura Slinkman)
Garage makeovers including rust cleanup and full repaint (Mattflix review)
Kitchen cabinet refinishing/repainting (evidenced directly by the business's own Google photos: a deep green cabinet repaint and a separate cream/antique-white cabinet repaint)
services.pricing_note: No price list found anywhere public. Site uses the adapted variant: every job is quoted, call or text for a price, nothing invented.

reviews_verbatim.name: Janet Algeciras
reviews_verbatim.text: I'm extremely pleased with the staining work done on my stair railing and painting. The craftsmanship is outstanding, and the finish is perfect. He was professional, punctual, and completed the job efficiently. I highly recommend him for any interior or exterior painting/staining needs for your home or business.

reviews_verbatim.name: Rolando Montalvan
reviews_verbatim.text: We couldn't be happier with the incredible job the painters did on our apartment. Their work was extraordinarily detailed, meticulous, and precise from start to finish. Beyond the flawless walls, the wooden staircase they completed looks absolutely stunning and sumptuously luxurious, it has completely transformed our space into a high-end masterpiece. True professionals who take genuine pride in their craft. Highly recommended!

reviews_verbatim.name: Laura Slinkman
reviews_verbatim.text: Communication was thorough and timely throughout the whole process from the proposal to completion of having our newly remodeled stair case stained and painted. The team was meticulous, detailed, arrived on time and cleaned up every day. The result was absolutely amazing. Hands down, best painting service we have ever used and will be using them again for future projects. So happy we found them!

reviews_verbatim.name: Kristen S
reviews_verbatim.text: Yandry and ipaint services were a pleasure to work with. Their attention to detail, cleanliness, and communication were top notch. Highly recommend!!

reviews_verbatim.name: Mattflix
reviews_verbatim.text: Fantastic work. Fast, prompt. Incredible communication. And the job looks amazing! My garage had rust and other issues and I needed to get it cleaned up and painted. I texted with them ahead of time, got a quote, and answered questions they needed to complete the job. We scheduled a time and date. The guys arrived right on time and got to work. Couldn't be more pleased. Will definitely be reaching back out to them with any future painting needs.

reviews_note: 5 reviews provided in the task brief, all verified real Google reviews (5 stars each). The owner/operator name 'Yandry' comes directly from Kristen S's review text ('Yandry and ipaint services were a pleasure to work with'), also confirmed by the business's own yard sign in its Google photos reading 'iPaint Services'. Used the 3 richest/most detailed quotes (Janet Algeciras, Rolando Montalvan, Laura Slinkman) for the site's 3-testimonial grid, per the build instructions; Kristen S and Mattflix were used as supporting source material for the 'about' copy and services copy (owner name, garage/rust detail) but not quoted verbatim on the page itself.

gallery.note: Hero image: a dramatic two-story curved staircase with rich stained wood treads/handrail, wrought-iron balusters and a chandelier-lit foyer. The single most visually spectacular finished job among the 11 Google photos, matching review language like 'sumptuously luxurious' and 'high-end masterpiece.' Landscape, well lit, no clutter.

About section: a bright, modern staircase with light raw-wood treads/newels and black metal horizontal railing, showing a second distinct staining style (contemporary vs. the hero's traditional/ornate look).

About section: a straight staircase with dark stained wood treads and white painted risers, framed art visible on the stairwell wall, further staircase-staining evidence, different home from the hero and the modern-staircase photo.

Used as the small 'owner-operator' avatar next to Yandry's name (same pattern as the 1st Due Handyman precedent, which also used a finished-work photo in place of a personal headshot, since no personal photo of Yandry exists publicly). Shows a freshly painted two-story West Palm Beach home with the business's own yard sign in the foreground, reading 'iPaint Services, Painting & Structures, 561-909-5890, Social Media @ipaintservices' -- real, first-party proof of the business's identity and branding.

photo_curation_note: 11 Google Business Profile photo URLs were provided; downloaded all 11 with curl (UA + Referer header), all decoded as valid JPEGs (900x1200). Photo #1 and #2 in the provided list were byte-identical duplicates (confirmed via md5sum), leaving 10 unique real photos. All 10 were visually inspected one by one with the Read tool before any selection. One photo (a kitchen island counter shot showing some loose cables/a small monitor on the counter) was initially considered for exclusion as mildly cluttered but was kept as the 6th, least-critical gallery tile since no other unused real photo was available and it is still in-focus, well-lit, genuine finished work, not blurry/stock/captioned; everything else used is a clean, uncluttered, finished-work shot. No selfies, no process/POV shots, no screenshots or graphics with text were present in the source set, so nothing had to be discarded for those reasons. 9 of the 10 unique photos are used on the page; one (the duplicate) was discarded entirely.
brand_vibe: Built on templates/dark-v2, repainted from the original warm-gold palette to a steel-blue family (hue 205) via the standard colorsys hue-rotation in derive.py/aplicar_paleta, chosen per the build brief for a clean, professional painting-contractor feel (sat_mult 1.0, light_mult 1.0, i.e. no additional desaturation/darkening beyond the hue shift). The gold Merktop badge was protected and untouched as always.
